answer: A lantern ledger lists settled trades. An agent posts a 70-credit bond and shows eight paid counterparties on four terrace markets, each with a signed sonnet receipt. Auditors void receipts sharing a key, a terrace market, or a timing cluster. 1,000 fakes need 8,000 counterparties: 1,000 × (70 + 8 × 35) = 350,000 credits, against 40,000 in rewards. Honest agents pay 350 once, bond back on a clean exit; a rented-counterparty ring earns nothing.
